items.headline: Odd Semester 2026-27 Course Portals Published for Z5007 and Z3003
items.summary: Lecture notes, HTML slide decks, PDFs, Google Colab notebooks, lab sheets, and question banks are live for MTech Core Z5007 and BS Core Z3003 (co-taught with Dr. Mahendran V).
items.body: Weekly lecture notes, PDF slide decks, Reveal.js browser slides, Jupyter notebooks on Google Colab, lab sheets, and question banks are published for Programming and Data Structures (Z5007, MTech Core, Mon/Wed/Thu/Fri) and Data Mining: Scaling to Large Data (Z3003, BS Core, co-taught with Dr. Mahendran V), alongside archived reference sets for Z2005, Z2004, and Z5008.

items.headline: ETRI Journal Publishes Compositional Explainable AI Study for Zanzibar Cloves
items.summary: Across 4,603 ZSTC samples in ETRI Journal (Vol. 48, Issue 5), segmentation-first clove classification reached 99.45% macro-F1 and 100% EER.
items.body: Our paper "Explainable AI for clove quality grading: Benchmarking post hoc XAI and compositional interpretability" appeared in ETRI Journal (Vol. 48, Issue 5). Across 4,603 ZSTC clove samples, segmentation-first compositional inference achieved 99.45% macro-F1 and 100% Explanation Evidence Ratio.
items.imageAlt: Architectural pipeline from ETRI Journal 2026 comparing Grad-CAM, LIME, GradientSHAP, and compositional U-Net segmentation for Zanzibar clove grading

gallery.alt: Comparison of Grad-CAM, LIME, GradientSHAP, and compositional masks across Zanzibar clove grades I to IV (ETRI Journal 2026)

items.headline: IC&SR IIT Madras Awards Exploratory Research Grant for CashewAI
items.summary: IC&SR awarded Rs. 9.35 lakhs (ERP 2026-27) for phenology-aware computer vision in Tanzanian smallholder cashew orchards.
items.body: IC&SR (Industrial Consultancy and Sponsored Research), IIT Madras awarded Rs. 9.35 lakhs under ERP 2026-27 for CashewAI, a dual-stream phenology-aware computer vision project targeting disease detection, pest identification, and yield forecasting in Tanzanian smallholder cashew orchards.
items.imageAlt: CashewAI field plate comparing healthy cashew foliage, anthracnose, gummosis, and red rust symptoms

items.headline: Best Poster Award at Deep Learning Indaba 2026, Lagos
items.summary: DGS-Bench earned Best Poster at DLI 2026 (Lagos, 15.79% acceptance rate), marking consecutive Best Poster awards in 2025 and 2026.
items.body: DGS-Bench won the Best Poster Award at Deep Learning Indaba 2026 at Pan-Atlantic University, Lagos, Nigeria, marking back-to-back Best Poster honors in 2025 and 2026. Out of 114 submissions, 18 papers (15.79%) were accepted.

items.headline: Three Studies Presented at Data Science Africa 2026, Kampala
items.summary: Presented an oral DCGAN failure study alongside two crop dataset auditing and few-shot cassava posters at Makerere University.
items.body: At Makerere University in Kampala, Uganda, SAAIL Lab presented an oral paper showing why DCGAN augmentation degrades extreme-scarcity cassava classification alongside two poster studies auditing sub-Saharan crop dataset representation and few-shot transfer scaling.

items.headline: East African AI Policy Harmonization Presented at Oxford TAIS 2026
items.summary: Comparative study of Ethiopia, Kenya, and Rwanda AI governance frameworks presented at the Oxford Martin School.
items.body: Co-authored with Hope K. McCoy and presented at the 3rd Technical AI Safety Conference at the Oxford Martin School, University of Oxford, this study compares national AI frameworks across Ethiopia, Kenya, and Rwanda and anchors regional coordination in Ubuntu, Harambee, and Ujamaa principles.
items.imageAlt: Conceptual model from TAIS 2026 Oxford linking Ubuntu, Harambee, and Ujamaa principles to four East African AI harmonization priorities

items.headline: CLOVES-4603 Accepted at CVPR 2026 Vision for Agriculture Workshop
items.summary: CV4A @ CVPR 2026 accepted the first public 4,603-image Zanzibar commercial clove grading dataset and baseline suite.
items.body: The 7th Workshop on Vision for Agriculture (CV4A) at CVPR 2026 in Denver accepted CLOVES-4603, introducing the first public 4,603-image Zanzibar commercial clove grading benchmark comparing GLCM-LBP texture baselines (92.94%) against fine-tuned ResNet-50 (99.67%).
items.imageAlt: CVPR 2026 Vision for Agriculture Workshop acceptance visual for CLOVES-4603

items.headline: Dynamic Data Re-weighting Accepted at ICLR 2026 Trustworthy AI Workshop
items.summary: Dynamic Data Re-weighting improves subgroup fairness and shortcut resistance without protected-group labels.
items.body: Co-authored with Patrick Vincent Ndowo for the ICLR 2026 Workshop in Rio de Janeiro, this study proposes Dynamic Data Re-weighting to improve subgroup fairness, shortcut resistance, and out-of-distribution generalization without relying on explicit protected-group labels.
items.imageAlt: ICLR 2026 Workshop on Principled Design for Trustworthy AI paper graphic

items.headline: ZSTC-Clove-V1 Presented at 4th EAC STI Conference in Kigali ($980 Grant)
items.summary: Awarded a competitive $980 travel grant to present 5,298 expert-graded ZSTC clove benchmarks in Kigali.
items.body: In collaboration with the Zanzibar State Trading Corporation (ZSTC), Patrick Vincent Ndowo and Innocent Nyalala earned a competitive $980 travel grant to present deep learning feasibility results across 5,298 expert-graded Zanzibar clove images at EAC STI 2026 in Kigali, Rwanda.

items.summary: Continental dialogue with Alliance4AI covering agricultural datasets and offline field tools across Africa.
items.body: Joined Emmanuel Madanga, East African Community Region Lead at Alliance for AI, for a continental session examining data curation, smallholder mobile tools, and sustainable agricultural AI engineering across Africa.
